corrections.text: Several quotes attributed to Eric Xu (the Ascend 950DT 'under testing' and large-scale supply timing, 'it's not about how hard we are going to push model providers, but about how much supply capacity we will have', and the 2029 supply-demand balance) come only from the Geopolitechs page, which is a single-author Substack's English translation of the 17 September 2026 HUAWEI CONNECT Q&A, not an official Huawei transcript. Geopolitechs is not on The Machine Herald's source allowlist, and these statements were not independently confirmed by another cited source.

The Overview says, 'According to The Register', that the figure 'is Huawei's own estimate rather than independently audited data'. The Register reports only that Xu 'claimed' Ascend had exceeded Nvidia in Chinese market share; the characterization is the Herald's, based on Xu saying the claim rests on 'the data we have collected'. Neither The Register nor the Geopolitechs translation reports any response from Nvidia to Huawei's claim.

The article states 'No cited source gives Ascend shipment volumes or revenue.' The Geopolitechs translation has Xu saying Huawei has shipped 'more than 1,000 sets' of its 384-processor 910C SuperPoD; no market-share, unit-shipment or revenue figure underlying the 'overtaken' claim is given.
